captions.detailed: A medieval stone-throwing bombard featuring a wide, squat, dark cast-iron barrel cradled in a fixed brown wooden bed. The cylindrical barrel is supported on both sides by side bracket cheeks, allowing it to pivot on a horizontal elevation revolute joint. A small rectangular touch-hole cover plate is hinged at the top of the barrel's breech via a secondary revolute joint.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a medieval stone-throwing bombard with a thick, squat cast-iron barrel mounted on a wooden bed cradle. The barrel should be able to pivot on a horizontal elevation axis between the side cheeks, and include a small hinged touch-hole cover on its top breech.
captions.factory: Construct the wooden bed cradle from rectangular boxes to form the base beams, bed floor, and stepped side cheeks. Model the squat barrel using a cylinder with a concentric cylindrical bore cut, adding a flared muzzle ring. Place two cylindrical trunnions on the sides of the barrel to fit into the side cheek slots, and mount a small rectangular cover plate on top of the breech via a revolute joint.
